mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is a correct property of a square?

options.A: All four sides are equal and all interior angles are 90°.
options.B: Only opposite sides are equal and all interior angles are 90°.
options.C: All four sides are equal but interior angles can be any value.
options.D: Opposite sides are parallel but adjacent sides are of different lengths.

mcqs.answer: All four sides are equal and all interior angles are 90°.
mcqs.explanation: A square is a quadrilateral with four equal sides and four right angles. Option B describes a rectangle, C is false because a square must have right angles, and D does not guarantee equal sides.

mcqs.question: A quadrilateral has all sides equal and all interior angles equal to 90°. Which special quadrilateral does it represent?
mcqs.explanation: Only a square possesses both the properties of a rectangle (right angles) and a rhombus (all sides equal). Hence it is the correct choice. The other options lack one of these properties.

mcqs.question: If a quadrilateral has all four sides equal but its interior angles are not all 90°, which type does it belong to?
mcqs.explanation: A rhombus is defined by having all sides equal; right angles are not required. A square would need right angles, so option C is incorrect. Rectangle requires opposite sides equal, not all four, and a generic parallelogram does not guarantee equal sides.

mcqs.question: A garden plot is a quadrilateral where opposite sides are parallel, all interior angles are 90°, and adjacent sides are of different lengths. Which quadrilateral best describes the plot?
mcqs.explanation: A rectangle has opposite sides equal and parallel with all right angles, while adjacent sides may differ. The description matches a rectangle. A square would require all sides equal, which is not the case here.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is NOT a property of a rhombus?

options.D: Its diagonals bisect each other at right angles.

mcqs.explanation: A rhombus does not require right angles; it only needs equal sides. Options A, B, and D are true properties of a rhombus, making C the incorrect statement.

mcqs.question: A quadrilateral is known to have all four sides equal and one interior angle equal to 90°. What can be concluded about the quadrilateral?

options.A: It is a rectangle but not necessarily a square.
options.B: It is a rhombus but not necessarily a square.

mcqs.explanation: If a quadrilateral has all sides equal (rhombus condition) and even one right angle, the opposite angles must also be right angles, making all angles 90°. Hence it satisfies both rectangle and rhombus conditions, i.e., it is a square. Options A and B miss the combination, and D is too general.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the inclusion relationships among the special quadrilaterals?

options.A: Every square is a rectangle, and every rectangle is a parallelogram.
options.B: Every rhombus is a square, and every square is a parallelogram.
options.C: Every rectangle is a square, and every square is a rhombus.
options.D: Every parallelogram is a rectangle, and every rectangle is a rhombus.

mcqs.answer: Every square is a rectangle, and every rectangle is a parallelogram.
mcqs.explanation: A square satisfies the definition of a rectangle (right angles) and a rectangle satisfies the definition of a parallelogram (opposite sides parallel). Options B, C, and D reverse or misuse the hierarchy, making them incorrect.

mcqs.question: In a competitive examination, a question asks: "Which quadrilateral necessarily has both pairs of opposite sides parallel and all four sides equal?" Which answer is correct?
mcqs.explanation: While a rhombus has all sides equal and opposite sides parallel, it does not guarantee right angles. Only a square guarantees both equal sides and right angles, satisfying the condition of both pairs of opposite sides being parallel (as in any parallelogram) and all sides equal. Hence, option C is the only correct choice.
